endangerment.comment: West Uvean (11042-uve) = Vulnerable (100 percent certain, based on the evidence available) (Fagauvea is spoken in the districts of Saint-Joseph, Imone and Takeji in the north of the island and the district Muli in the south. In Saint-Joseph it is the principal language of the Teuta, Takeji and Heo people, while in the southern part it is mainly spoken by the Muli and Lekin people.) [Djoupa 2013](cldf:djoupa:13)
